title: Streaming Data Engineer
summary: A streaming data engineer builds pipelines that process data the moment it is produced, rather than in nightly batches. They sit in a data or platform team, running Kafka and stream processors like Flink so that events flow reliably into apps, dashboards and warehouses in real time.
dailyDuties: Build real-time pipelines with Flink or Kafka Streams
Run Kafka topics, Connect and Schema Registry
Design event schemas and handle their evolution
Query and transform streams and tables with SQL
Debug lag, backpressure and exactly-once issues
Land streams into lakehouse tables for analytics
Version and review pipeline code with the team
